_about: The Priorities yardstick outside Florida: the James Fishback platform (Tyler's pick for Ballot Buddy), with Florida-only details swapped for the state, per form note_9306 Q3. {S} = state, {P} = its people. Florida keeps its own original text in research3/priorities.json. Plank ids match Florida's so the app and scoring code are shared.
summary: This is the platform Ballot Buddy scores against, adapted to {S}. James Fishback ran on it in the 2026 Republican primary for Florida governor: an affordability and land-protection message on top of a conservative base. Details that only applied to Florida have been swapped for {S}. It's one yardstick, chosen by this guide, and not a neutral one.

planks.title: Ban data centers statewide
planks.promise: Ban AI and hyperscale data centers in every {S} county through statewide preemption of county approvals, to protect farmland, water and electric bills.
planks.tells_for: Votes or stated positions to ban, put a moratorium on, or preempt data-center approvals; opposing data-center rezonings on farmland; refusing data-center-industry money.
planks.tells_against: Votes to approve or fast-track a data center, rezone farmland for one, or give it tax breaks; campaigning on attracting data centers or AI infrastructure.

planks.title: Eliminate homestead property taxes
planks.promise: Eliminate property taxes on {S} residents' primary homes (not second homes, short-term rentals or mega-estates), paid for by rolling local government spending back.
planks.tells_for: Votes for homestead exemption increases, assessment caps or abolition; pledges to cut or end homestead taxes; pledges to cut local spending or tax rates.
planks.tells_against: Votes or statements for raising property taxes; opposing homestead tax relief; defending local government revenue growth.

planks.title: {S} homes and land for {P}
planks.promise: Ban private equity and Wall Street firms from buying single-family homes, tax out-of-state vacation-home buyers, and keep foreign adversaries from owning {S} land.
planks.tells_for: Supporting limits on institutional or foreign buyers of homes and land; proposing taxes or caps on out-of-state or investor purchases.
planks.tells_against: Opposing limits on corporate or foreign land buying; courting institutional or foreign real-estate capital.

planks.title: Slow growth, protect land and water
planks.promise: Develop slower and smarter, stop overdevelopment, and conserve {S}'s state parks, waterways and natural lands.
planks.tells_for: Votes or statements to hold or tighten growth limits, require approvals for large developments, deny rezonings of farmland or open space, fund conservation; refusing developer money.
planks.tells_against: Votes to expand development boundaries, waive development oversight, preempt local growth limits, approve large developer land deals over resident objections; heavy developer funding.

planks.title: {S} workers first: end H-1B
planks.promise: End H-1B abuse with fines that wipe out any savings from replacing a {S} worker, keep H-1B workers off state contracts, raise foreign-student tuition, and back strong immigration enforcement and deportations.
planks.tells_for: Votes or statements for state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement, E-Verify, detention of criminal illegal immigrants, limiting H-1B or guest-worker displacement of Americans.
planks.tells_against: Votes or statements against immigration-enforcement bills; defending H-1B or guest-worker expansion or sanctuary-style policies.

planks.title: No foreign or big-donor money
planks.promise: Refuse contributions from foreign-affiliated groups (naming AIPAC) and run against donor capture.
planks.tells_for: Stated pledges to refuse foreign-linked, corporate-PAC, developer or out-of-state big-donor money; small-dollar funded campaigns.
planks.tells_against: Documented reliance on developer, foreign-linked or mega-donor or PAC money; stated openness to it.

planks.title: Back police, restore order
planks.promise: Raise pay and improve pensions for law enforcement and corrections officers, charge teen takeovers as felonies, surge state resources on homelessness, and remove prosecutors who refuse to prosecute.
planks.tells_for: Votes or positions raising penalties for rioting or disorder, funding or improving pay and pensions for officers, supporting police, tough-on-crime prosecution.
planks.tells_against: Votes cutting officer pensions or benefits; opposing penalties for public disorder; defund-style positions.

planks.title: Defend the Second Amendment
planks.promise: Eliminate Red Flag laws, end restrictions on suppressors, bump stocks and forced-reset triggers, and oppose raising gun purchase ages; also pull Flock cameras and stop Palantir contracts.
planks.tells_for: Votes for permitless carry and stand-your-ground, against red-flag laws and new purchase-age limits; pledges to oppose new gun restrictions.
planks.tells_against: Votes for red-flag laws, purchase-age or waiting-period laws, assault-weapon or magazine limits.

planks.title: Pro-life, no exceptions
planks.promise: Life begins at conception; shut down {S}'s abortion clinics and replace them with crisis pregnancy centers, plus paid maternity leave.
planks.tells_for: Votes or statements for abortion bans, waiting periods or other abortion restrictions; support for pregnancy centers.
planks.tells_against: Votes or statements against abortion restrictions; support for abortion-access measures.

planks.title: School choice and teacher pay
planks.promise: Universal school choice funded toward parity with public schools, a state homeschool commissioner, and a 25% raise for teachers.
planks.tells_for: Votes or statements for vouchers, charters or universal choice and for raising teacher pay.
planks.tells_against: Votes or statements against voucher or charter expansion or school-choice funding.
